page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7i.32xlarge is a bare-metal GPU-accelerated server instance designed for demanding compute and graphics workloads. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this instance features 128 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, ensuring consistent and predictable CPU performance without hyperthreading overhead. It is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 6.0 GB of RAM per core to support data-intensive operations.

The hardware configuration includes four NVIDIA A10 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 96 GB of VRAM. This GPU acceleration is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating rapid data transfer and communication across distributed systems. The instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through attached network storage volumes.

Given the combination of 128 dedicated cores, substantial system memory, and quad NVIDIA A10 GPUs, the ecs.ebmgn7i.32xlarge is optimized for workloads such as deep learning inference, medium-scale AI model training, high-performance computing, 3D rendering, and video transcoding. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the bare-metal architecture eliminates virtualization overhead, maximizing the return on hardware resources for highly parallelized, GPU-dependent enterprise applications.
